question: In addition to his puppeteering on The Dark Crystal, Dave Goelz is known for performing as which Muppet?
contexts: Dave Goelz is an American puppeteer best known for his work with the Muppets. He performed The Great Gonzo, Bunsen Honeydew, Zoot, and Waldorf.
The Dark Crystal is a 1982 American-British fantasy film directed by Jim Henson and Frank Oz. Dave Goelz was one of the film's puppeteers.
The Great Gonzo, also known as Gonzo the Great, is a Muppet character who has been performed by Dave Goelz since 1976.
Sesame Street is an American educational children's television series created by Joan Ganz Cooney and Lloyd Morrisett.
